tool.name: studio_inspect_case
tool.description: Read-only bounded input/provenance inspection of one validated saved case. Obtain snapshot-local caseId, expectedRevision and expectedArchiveRevision from studio_compare_cases listing. Section/pointer/page contracts match studio_inspect_project section mode; expectedInputRevision pins the nested input revision. Nested values and long strings are discoverable through explicit pointers/pages. Never applies inputs or solves; source bytes/hash are rechecked before return; response <=65536 UTF-8 bytes. Missing build/source evidence is not inferred.

source.identityScope: snapshot-local deterministic IDs; valid only with matching case and archive revisions
